newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyotaru says some firms mulling help.
newsitem.headline: Kyotaru says some firms mulling help.

text.p: Kyotaru Co Ltd, a troubled restaurant chain operator, said on Friday that a number of firms were considering offering it assistance in its efforts to restructure.

But a spokesman for the company said he could not confirm a report in the Japanese financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun that a total of 10 firms, including food maker Katokichi Co Ltd and fast-food chain operator Yoshinoya D & C Co Ltd, were interested in helping to restructure Kyotaru.
"We only know that several companies are considering extending assistance to us," said the Kyotaru spokesman.
Spokesmen for both Katokichi and Yoshinoya denied that their companies were mulling such a move.
Kyotaru, which operates a chain of sushi restaurants, sought protection from creditors under Japan's bankruptcy laws last month in order to restructure its operations.
